batch.selection: Microsoft 405 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 1 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3

results.title: Agent hooks
results.description: Add fail-closed governance and runtime controls to agents with the Agent Hooks interception contract.

scores.rationale: Agent Hooks 给出失败关闭的拦截契约，可统一落实治理、策略和运行时控制。

results.title: Background agents
results.description: Delegate concurrent work to background agents and manage task creation, completion, result retrieval, continuation, and cleanup.

scores.rationale: 后台智能体的并发委派、结果回收和生命周期管理是长任务系统的核心机制。

results.title: Agent Background Responses
results.description: Learn how to handle long-running operations with background responses in Agent Framework

scores.rationale: 后台响应的异步契约直接影响长耗时调用的可靠实现，但接口形态可能随框架演进。

results.title: CodeAct
results.description: Learn what CodeAct is and when to use it with Agent Framework.

scores.rationale: CodeAct 展示以代码作为行动空间的独特智能体范式，机制价值高但适用场景较集中。

results.title: Declarative Agents
results.description: Learn how to define agents declaratively using configuration files in Agent Framework.

scores.rationale: 声明式智能体有配置、复现与治理价值，但主要服务采用该框架的团队。

results.title: Evaluation
results.description: Learn how to evaluate agents and workflows in Agent Framework using local checks, custom evaluators, and Microsoft Foundry.

scores.rationale: 评测资料覆盖本地检查、自定义评估器与工作流评估，是上线前质量闭环的核心。

results.title: Agent looping
results.description: Re-invoke agents safely with bounded loops, completion evaluators, AI judges, progress feedback, and approval escape behavior.

scores.rationale: 有界循环、完成判定和审批逃生机制是可靠智能体控制的通用方法。

results.title: Using images with an agent
results.description: Learn how to use images with an agent

scores.rationale: 页面主要说明如何向 Agent Framework 传入图像，属于操作步骤且可由多模态主资料替代。

results.title: Observability
results.description: Learn how to use observability with Agent Framework

scores.rationale: 追踪、指标和遥测是生产智能体诊断与持续改进的基础能力。

results.title: Planning and todos
results.description: Structure long-running agent work with todo and agent-mode providers, custom persistence, and plan-execute patterns.

scores.rationale: 计划—执行、待办持久化和进度反馈对长任务智能体具有广泛架构价值。

results.title: RAG
results.description: Learn how to use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with Agent Framework

scores.rationale: RAG 与智能体结合具有重要实践价值，但多数原理可由独立 RAG 主资料覆盖。

results.title: Agent Security with FIDES
results.description: Defend Agent Framework agents against prompt injection and data exfiltration with FIDES (Flow Integrity Deterministic Enforcement System), an information-flow control middleware for tracking content trust and confidentiality.

scores.rationale: FIDES 以信息流控制处理提示注入和数据外泄，提供不可由一般安全清单替代的机制。

results.title: Agent Skills
results.description: Learn how to extend agent capabilities with Agent Skills - portable packages of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents discover and load on demand.

scores.rationale: Agent Skills 的按需发现与加载协议是可移植能力封装的重要新范式。

results.title: Producing Structured Outputs with Agents
results.description: Learn how to use structured outputs with an agent

scores.rationale: 结构化输出是可靠工具链、验证和下游自动化的基础契约。

results.title: Tools Overview
results.description: Overview of tool types available in Agent Framework and provider support matrix.

scores.rationale: 工具类型与提供商支持矩阵只是导航性总览，具体知识已由各工具主资料覆盖。

results.title: Code Interpreter
results.description: Learn how to use the Code Interpreter tool with Agent Framework agents.

scores.rationale: Code Interpreter 页面偏单一托管工具接入，缺少独立且广泛适用的机制增量。

results.title: Controlling tool availability
results.description: How to progressively expose tools, gate tool calls, and enforce ordering within an agent run (Python).

scores.rationale: 渐进暴露、调用门控和顺序约束直接降低工具误用，是通用智能体控制方法。

results.title: File Search
results.description: Learn how to use the File Search tool with Agent Framework agents.

scores.rationale: File Search 页面偏框架工具调用，检索原理由 RAG 与检索主资料更完整覆盖。

results.title: Using function tools with an agent
results.description: Learn how to use function tools with an agent

scores.rationale: 函数工具的模式、调用与结果回传是智能体连接外部能力的核心机制。

results.title: Using hosted MCP tools with agents
results.description: Use hosted Model Context Protocol tools with Agent Framework agents.

scores.rationale: 托管 MCP 的执行边界和服务端契约具有官方独有性，但产品实现变化较快。

results.title: Using MCP tools with Agents
results.description: Using MCP tools with agents

scores.rationale: 本地 MCP 工具的发现、会话和调用模式对开放工具互操作具有广泛价值。

results.title: Using function tools with human in the loop approvals
results.description: Learn how to use function tools with human in the loop approvals

scores.rationale: 工具审批把高风险行动纳入人在回路，是生产智能体安全的关键控制点。

results.title: Web Search
results.description: Learn how to use the Web Search tool with Agent Framework agents.

scores.rationale: Web Search 页面主要是单一托管搜索工具接入，可由工具调用和检索资料替代。

results.title: Agent concepts
results.description: Understand Agent Framework agent types, runtime execution, conversations, middleware, and safety.

scores.rationale: 智能体概念页提供统一术语入口，但大量细节已由下属机制页面覆盖。

results.title: Agent pipeline architecture
results.description: Understand how agents build their internal pipeline of middleware, context providers, and chat clients.

scores.rationale: 内部管线解释中间件、上下文提供器与模型客户端的组合顺序，是理解框架行为的关键。

results.title: Conversations & Memory overview
results.description: Learn the core AgentSession usage pattern and how to navigate sessions, context providers, and storage.

scores.rationale: 会话与记忆总览建立必要概念边界，但独立增量主要来自后续专题页。

results.title: Chat History Memory Provider
results.description: Learn how to use the Chat History Memory Provider to add semantic memory capabilities to your Agent Framework agents by storing and retrieving chat history from a vector store.

scores.rationale: 以向量检索恢复历史的语义记忆模式可迁移到多数长程智能体系统。

results.title: Compaction
results.description: Learn how to manage conversation history size with compaction strategies that keep context within token limits.

scores.rationale: 上下文压缩直接解决令牌预算、信息保真和长会话稳定性问题。

results.title: Context Providers
results.description: Learn built-in and custom context provider patterns, including history provider guidance.

scores.rationale: 上下文提供器把记忆、检索和运行信息组织为可插拔注入机制，适用面广。

results.title: Session
results.description: Learn what AgentSession contains and how to create, restore, and serialize sessions.

scores.rationale: 会话的创建、恢复和序列化是有状态智能体可靠运行的基础契约。

results.title: Storage
results.description: Learn built-in storage modes and how to persist session state or plug in external storage.

scores.rationale: 状态持久化和外部存储抽象对可恢复智能体有稳定工程价值。

results.title: Custom Agents
results.description: Learn how to build custom agents with Microsoft Agent Framework.

scores.rationale: 自定义智能体说明扩展边界，但内容较依赖 Agent Framework 实现。

results.title: Agent Middleware
results.description: Learn how to create middleware with Agent Framework

scores.rationale: 中间件是横切治理、观测、安全和策略注入的核心扩展机制。

results.title: Agent vs Run Scope
results.description: Learn about agent-level and run-level middleware scoping in Agent Framework.

scores.rationale: 区分智能体级与单次运行级作用域可避免状态泄漏和错误复用，结论较独特。

results.title: Chat-Level Middleware
results.description: Learn how to implement chat-level middleware in Agent Framework.

scores.rationale: 聊天级中间件是框架内部的窄作用域实现，缺少独立知识增量。

results.title: Adding Middleware to Agents
results.description: How to add middleware to an agent

scores.rationale: 页面主要讲添加中间件的代码步骤，核心机制已由中间件总览覆盖。

results.title: Exception Handling
results.description: Learn how to handle exceptions in middleware.

scores.rationale: 异常处理属于通用编程实践，页面未形成智能体领域不可替代的结论。

results.title: Result Overrides
results.description: Learn how to override agent results using middleware.

scores.rationale: 结果覆盖是框架特定扩展点，适用范围窄且由中间件主资料涵盖。

results.title: Runtime Context
results.description: Learn how to use runtime context in middleware.

scores.rationale: 运行时上下文明确依赖注入与单次执行隔离，对中间件设计有实际价值。

results.title: Shared State
results.description: Learn how to share state across middleware components.

scores.rationale: 共享状态解释多个中间件协作时的状态边界，具有可复用工程价值。

results.title: Termination & Guardrails
results.description: Learn how to implement termination conditions and guardrails with middleware.

scores.rationale: 终止条件与护栏共同约束智能体失控，是安全运行的关键机制。

results.title: Running Agents
results.description: Learn how to run agents with Agent Framework

scores.rationale: 页面主要说明启动和调用智能体的基本步骤，属于入门操作。

results.title: Switch models and inference providers at runtime
results.description: Understand when an agent can switch models or inference providers during a conversation without losing context.

scores.rationale: 运行中切换模型或推理提供商且保持上下文，是模型路由与韧性的独特架构问题。

results.title: Agent Safety
results.description: Security best practices for building safe and secure AI agents with Agent Framework.

scores.rationale: 安全最佳实践覆盖输入、工具、权限与输出边界，对生产智能体普遍适用。

results.title: Agent Harness
results.description: Understand how the Agent Framework Harness composes an agentic runtime and how to create and customize a harness agent.

scores.rationale: Harness 展示组合式智能体运行时边界，官方架构说明独特但框架依赖较强。

results.title: Workflow concepts
results.description: Understand Agent Framework workflow APIs, graph primitives, execution, state, and advanced composition.

scores.rationale: 工作流概念页建立图、执行和状态的统一入口，但专题页承担主要增量。

results.title: Agent Executor
results.description: Deep dive into the AgentExecutor, the built-in executor that adapts AI agents for use in workflows.

scores.rationale: AgentExecutor 说明智能体嵌入工作流的适配边界，达到最低保留线但较实现相关。

results.title: Workflow Execution Modes
results.description: Deep dive into the OffThread and Lockstep execution modes for .NET workflows.

scores.rationale: OffThread 与 Lockstep 页面主要针对 .NET 执行模式，跨平台学习价值有限。

results.title: Resettable Executors
results.description: How to implement IResettableExecutor to safely reuse stateful executors across workflow runs.

scores.rationale: 可重置执行器是 .NET 工作流的窄接口模式，不能形成独立核心知识。

results.title: Sub-Workflows
results.description: Deep dive into composing workflows by nesting them as executors within parent workflows.

scores.rationale: 子工作流组合支持分层编排、隔离与复用，是复杂工作流的重要通用机制。

results.title: Workflow Builder & Execution
results.description: Building and executing workflows with the WorkflowBuilder.

scores.rationale: 构建器与执行页面偏框架 API，但仍提供图构建与运行生命周期的完整最小模型。

results.title: Edges
results.description: Edges define how messages flow between executors in a workflow.

scores.rationale: 边定义消息路由、条件分支和数据流，是图工作流语义的核心。

results.title: Events
results.description: In-depth look at Events in Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows.

scores.rationale: 事件机制提供可观测的执行信号和外部协调接口，对工作流控制有稳定价值。

results.title: Executors
results.description: In-depth look at Executors in Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows.

scores.rationale: 执行器定义工作单元、状态和消息处理边界，是工作流运行模型的核心。

results.title: Functional Workflow API
results.description: Write workflows as plain Python async functions using the @workflow and @step decorators.

scores.rationale: 函数式工作流展示轻量编排模式，实用性高但装饰器接口可能变化。

results.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows - State
results.description: In-depth look at State in Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows.

scores.rationale: 工作流状态的范围、持久化与恢复语义决定长任务正确性和容错。

results.title: Durable Extension
results.description: Learn how to make C# and Python Agent Framework agents and workflows durable with Azure Functions or bring-your-own-compute hosting.

scores.rationale: Durable Extension 系统说明检查点、恢复和持久执行，对长任务可靠性普遍重要。

results.title: Foundry Hosted Agents
results.description: Learn how to host Agent Framework agents in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service as containerized, managed hosted agents.

scores.rationale: Foundry 托管智能体主要是 Microsoft 平台部署流程，跨平台知识增量不足。

results.title: Self-host Agent Framework applications
results.description: Build an application-owned server and add one or more Agent Framework protocols.

scores.rationale: 自托管协议与应用所有权边界对部署、治理和可移植性有直接价值。

results.title: Self-host A2A agents
results.description: Choose an opinionated A2A executor, an app-owned adapter, or conversion helpers for Agent Framework agents and workflows.

scores.rationale: A2A 自托管说明开放代理互操作、任务执行器与适配边界，具有独立协议价值。
